newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Profurn gets Botswana, Namibia listing okay.
newsitem.headline: Profurn gets Botswana, Namibia listing okay.

text.p: South Africa's Protea Furnishers Ltd (Profurn) said on Wednesday it had got listing approval from both the Namibian and Botswanan stock exchanges.
There had initially been some speculation that the Botswanan listing could be postponed, but the firm said it would now list in Namibia later on Wednesday and in Botswana on Thursday.

"(Profurn) applied for a dual listing...to demonstrate its commitment to the development of Namibia and Botswana and their respective economies and to ensure accessibility of its shares to the Namibian and Botswanan people," the firm said in a statement.
Profurn is the latest in a steady flow of South African-listed firms to seek to expand onto the bourses of Namibia and Botswana.
